chapter_name: A Journey to the Magical Mountains
learning_objective: 🎯 We will go on a fun adventure to learn about tall mountains cold snow and the beauty of nature!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Mountains are huge and tall rocky places that touch the clouds. Some very high mountains are covered in beautiful white snow.
Going on a journey helps us see new places and learn new things. The cold breeze and green trees make the mountains feel completely magical.

fun_activity.title: ⛺ Build a Mountain
fun_activity.instructions: Use old newspapers or clay to make a big mountain model and paint the top white to look like real snow!

quick_recap: ⭐ Mountains are tall and beautiful creations of nature.
⭐ Traveling to new places is a magical adventure.
⭐ We should keep our mountains clean and green.
